headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Stock Fair Value Falls After Cautious Q3 Analyst Revisions
headlines.summary: The latest analyst update on Netflix trims the fair value estimate from US$92.62 to US$86.24, pointing to a lower price target in current models. This shift lines up with Street research that has generally moved price targets lower after the Q3 2026 report, as analysts take a more cautious line on revenue growth, margins, and valuation multiples. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative around Netflix may shape the way you track the stock from here.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
